description: This Java class 'DefaultQueryLogComponent' implements query logging with performance threshold filtering and SQL parameter substitution for slow queries in a database access layer.

classes.name: DefaultQueryLogComponent
classes.description: A Spring component that logs slow SQL queries with parameter substitution.

methods.name: logQuery
methods.description: Logs a warning if a query exceeds the configured duration threshold and logging is enabled.

methods.name: substituteParametersInSqlString
methods.description: Replaces named parameters in SQL string with their actual values for clearer logging.

methods.name: getValueForSQLQuery
methods.description: Converts a parameter value to its SQL string representation, handling strings, UUIDs, and other objects.
